meta.title: fix(wallet): fix wallet page jank during coin activation
meta.body_summary: Avoids repeated pubkey fetch calls during coin activation by tracking in-flight requests in CoinsBloc, aiming to reduce wallet page jank.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex attempted to fix wallet jank by deduplicating pubkey fetches; maintainer tested but found no measurable improvement, author retracted to refine approach.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1620 changed lines this PR appears medium-to-large by raw volume, but 93% of the changes (1512 lines) come from a merge of the dev branch. The actual performance fix touches only lib/bloc/coins_bloc/coins_bloc.dart with 108 changes. The PR was closed without merge because the author could not demonstrate measurable improvement.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer smk762 tested the CI build and found no significant speed difference compared to production; they requested additional tests to justify the change.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduces wallet page jank by preventing repeated pubkey fetch calls during coin activation.
review_details.rejection_signals: Author converted PR to draft after realizing the fix did not produce measurable improvement; planned to revisit.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent proposed a reasonable deduplication change but could not provide benchmarks or measurable evidence; maintainer was unable to validate performance gains.

detection_detail.manual_testing: smk762 logged in with CI branch, observed UTXO and EMV load times, compared with production, found no significant difference.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, no repro steps beyond 'log in and compare feel'; author acknowledged need for empirical testing steps.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Author converted to draft and indicated intention to return after better testing, effectively abandoning the current PR.

core_change_summary.description: In lib/bloc/coins_bloc/coins_bloc.dart, added tracking of in-progress pubkey fetch requests using a Set of coin abbreviations to avoid redundant calls during coin activation, intended to reduce jank.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merge commit 4e5b8d5 brought in changes from dev branch across 50 files, unrelated to the performance fix.
